name: High-severity IDS alert
purpose: Promote high-severity network IDS alerts into the alert queue; ignore informational noise.
description: Matches IDS alerts with normalized severity 7 or higher, grouped by source and destination address.

attack.justification: No technique is asserted: an IDS signature name does not by itself prove a specific adversary behaviour.

playbook.what: The network sensor raised a high-severity alert for traffic from {src_ip} to {dst_ip}.
playbook.why: The sensor thinks the traffic resembles a known attack pattern.
playbook.howSure: Low to medium. Signatures produce false positives, and a match is not proof the attack succeeded.
next: Check whether {dst_ip} runs the service named in the signature.
Look for sign-ins to the destination from {src_ip} shortly afterwards.
Check whether a scanner or test is scheduled from {src_ip}.
verify: The destination shows no unexpected changes.
The alert does not recur after remediation or is confirmed benign.
alternatives: Benign traffic that resembles a signature.
